title: Scholarships for International Students studying at Freie Universität Berlin
summary: Freie Universität Berlin offers STIBET I scholarships funded by DAAD for expanding access to international degree-seeking students enrolled at FU Berlin who face specific life circumstances like refugee backgrounds, childcare, caregiving responsibilities, or disabilities/chronic illnesses.

degree_levels.notes: Not available for PhD students and exchange students.

subject_areas.notes: All disciplines/subjects are eligible as no restrictions are stated.

institutions.notes: Must be currently enrolled at Freie Universität Berlin.

nationality.notes: Must be international students and not currently German citizens; entrance qualification for higher-education must have been obtained abroad.

residence.notes: Students are currently enrolled at Freie Universität Berlin in Germany.

mandatory.text: Must be an international student currently enrolled at Freie Universität Berlin pursuing a degree (Bachelor, State Exam, Master)
Must have obtained higher-education entrance qualification abroad
Must not be currently a German citizen
Must belong to at least one target group: refugee background, child/children under 12, caregiver, or with disabilities (degree of at least 50) or chronic illnesses
Must have regularly attended university classes (successfully completed at least one course per semester or attended at least 2 courses if in first semester)
Must be enrolled at FU Berlin during the entire funding period (March 1, 2026 - December 31, 2026)

funding.description: Monthly grant of 250 Euros over a 10-month period from March to December 2026. Other scholarships and/or income from work may be taken into account; public funding up to a full scholarship of 992 euros/month is possible, and gross additional income from work plus scholarship may not exceed 1,548 euros/month.

required_documents.text: Certificate of enrollment or study certificate (Immatrikutationsbescheinigung or Studienbescheinigung)
Documentation of classes attended, such as a current transcript of records (Leistungsübersicht)
Copy of entrance qualification for higher-education (such as high school diploma)
Document of citizenship (such as current passport)
Documentation regarding the applicant’s eligibility to apply (official documents, medical documentation, birth certificate, care certificate, etc.)

steps.text: Complete and submit the online application form on or before the application deadline
Send a certificate of enrollment or study certificate and a transcript of records to international@studienberatung.fu-berlin.de by January 11, 2026
Attend a personal interview in February if invited by the selection committee
